title: Sokoni
text: Kila Jumamosi Maria huenda sokoni. Soko liko katikati ya mji. Jua linawaka na kuna watu wengi sana. Maria anapenda soko hili kwa sababu matunda ni freshi na bei ni nafuu. Kwanza ananunua matofaa na machungwa. Kisha ananunua mkate, jibini na samaki kidogo. Muuzaji wa samaki ni mchangamfu sana. Kila mara anamuuliza habari za familia yake. Sokoni Maria hukutana mara nyingi na rafiki yake Elena. Leo wanakunywa kahawa pamoja na kuzungumza kwa muda mrefu. Saa sita mchana Maria anarudi nyumbani na mifuko miwili mizito. Amechoka lakini ana furaha.

questions.q: Maria hukutana na nani mara nyingi sokoni?

notice: A Swahili verb is built from pieces: "a-na-nunua" is "she-now-buy", so "ananunua" is "she buys". The start "hu-" means something happens regularly: "huenda" (usually goes). "Sokoni" is "at the market": -ni means "at" or "in".
back: Kwanza ananunua matofaa na machungwa.
First she buys apples and oranges.
Kila mara anamuuliza habari za familia yake.
He always asks about her family.

title: Siku yangu
text: Jina langu ni Daniel na ninaishi katika fleti ndogo. Kila asubuhi ninaamka saa moja. Kwanza ninakunywa chai na kula mkate na siagi. Kisha ninaenda kazini kwa basi. Ninafanya kazi katika duka la vitabu katikati ya jiji. Ninaipenda kazi yangu kwa sababu ninapenda vitabu. Saa sita mchana ninakula supu katika mkahawa mdogo. Alasiri wateja wengi huja dukani. Jioni ninarudi nyumbani na kupika chakula cha jioni. Baada ya chakula ninampigia mama yangu simu au ninasoma kitabu. Ninakwenda kulala saa tano usiku. Jumapili sifanyi kazi na ninalala kwa muda mrefu zaidi.

gloss.kulala: to sleep (ninakwenda kulala: I go to bed)

questions.q: Daniel huenda kazini kwa usafiri gani?
Daniel hula nini saa sita mchana?

notice: Swahili counts the hours from sunrise, so "saa moja" (hour one) is seven o'clock, "saa sita mchana" is noon and "saa tano usiku" is eleven at night. "Ni-na-" at the start of a verb means "I" and "now": "ninaishi" (I live).
back: Kisha ninaenda kazini kwa basi.
Then I go to work by bus.
Jioni ninarudi nyumbani na kupika chakula cha jioni.
In the evening I go home and cook dinner.

title: Wikendi baharini
text: Wikendi iliyopita mimi na kaka yangu tulikwenda baharini. Tulipanda treni asubuhi na mapema, na safari ilichukua saa tatu. Hali ya hewa ilikuwa nzuri sana: anga lilikuwa la buluu na maji yalikuwa ya vuguvugu. Tuliogelea kwa muda mrefu, kisha tukalala ufukweni. Saa sita mchana tulikula samaki freshi katika mkahawa mdogo karibu na bandari. Mhudumu alikuwa mchangamfu na alituletea maji baridi. Alasiri tulitembea katika mji wa kale na kununua postikadi. Kaka yangu alipiga picha nyingi za mashua. Jioni tulikuwa tumechoka sana, lakini hatukutaka kurudi nyumbani. Tulikosa treni ya mwisho na ilitubidi kusubiri saa moja. Ilikuwa siku bora kabisa ya kiangazi. Wakati ujao tunataka kukaa wiki nzima.

gloss.baharini: to the sea, at the sea (bahari: sea)

questions.q: Walisafiri kwenda baharini kwa usafiri gani?
Walinunua nini katika mji wa kale?

notice: The piece -li- puts a verb in the past: "tu-li-kwenda" is "we-did-go", so "tulikwenda" is "we went" and "alipiga" is "he took". "Hatu-ku-taka" (we did not want) shows the negative past, with ha- at the front and -ku- in the middle.
back: Alasiri tulitembea katika mji wa kale na kununua postikadi.
In the afternoon we walked through the old town and bought postcards.
Tulikosa treni ya mwisho na ilitubidi kusubiri saa moja.
We missed the last train and had to wait an hour.

title: Jirani mpya
text: Mwezi uliopita jirani mpya alihamia katika jengo letu. Jina lake ni Sofia na anatoka mji mwingine. Mwanzoni hakumjua mtu yeyote hapa. Jioni moja alibisha mlango wetu kwa sababu taa ya jikoni kwake ilikuwa imeharibika. Baba yangu alipanda juu na kuitengeneza kwa dakika kumi. Sofia alishukuru sana na siku iliyofuata alituletea keki. Keki ilikuwa tamu sana na mdogo wangu alikula vipande vitatu. Sasa Sofia hunywa chai mara nyingi pamoja na mama yangu. Anafanya kazi hospitalini na husimulia hadithi za kuvutia. Jana alinisaidia kufanya kazi yangu ya shule. Jumapili tulimwonyesha bustani na soko la zamani. Anasema kwamba tayari anajisikia kama yuko nyumbani. Nadhani tumepata rafiki mpya.

gloss.tumepata: we have got, we have found

questions.q: Nini kilikuwa kimeharibika jikoni kwa Sofia?

notice: Small pieces inside the verb say who receives the action: "a-li-tu-letea" is "she brought us", "a-li-ni-saidia" is "she helped me", "tu-li-mw-onyesha" is "we showed her". "Yangu" (my) and "wetu" (our) follow the noun: "baba yangu", "mlango wetu".
back: Baba yangu alipanda juu na kuitengeneza kwa dakika kumi.
My father went upstairs and repaired it in ten minutes.
Anafanya kazi hospitalini na husimulia hadithi za kuvutia.
She works in a hospital and tells interesting stories.

title: Mkahawani
lines: Habari za asubuhi! Nikuletee nini?
Nzuri, asante. Naomba kahawa ya maziwa, tafadhali.
Ungependa kula kitu chochote?
Ndiyo, mna keki gani leo?
Tuna keki ya tofaa na keki ya chokoleti.
Basi naomba kipande cha keki ya tofaa.
Karibu. Unahitaji kitu kingine?
Hapana, asante. Ni shilingi ngapi kwa jumla?
Shilingi elfu sita, tafadhali.
Hizi hapa pesa. Asante na kwaheri!
notice: "Naomba …" (I ask for …) is the polite way to order: "Naomba kahawa ya maziwa". "Tafadhali" is please and "asante" is thank you. The greeting "Habari za asubuhi?" (News of the morning?) is answered with "Nzuri" (Good).

title: Hotelini
lines: Habari za jioni. Nikusaidie nini?
Nzuri. Nimeweka nafasi ya chumba kwa usiku mbili.
Jina lako ni nani, tafadhali?
Jina langu ni Anna Berg. Hii hapa pasipoti yangu.
Asante. Chumba chako kiko ghorofa ya tatu.
Je, kifungua kinywa kimo ndani ya bei?
Ndiyo, kifungua kinywa ni kuanzia saa moja hadi saa nne asubuhi.
Vizuri sana. Je, kuna lifti? Sanduku langu ni zito.
Ndiyo, lifti iko karibu na ngazi. Huu hapa ufunguo wako.
Asante sana. Jioni njema!

gloss.ndani: inside (kimo ndani ya bei: it is included in the price)

questions.q: Mgeni ameweka nafasi kwa usiku ngapi?

notice: A yes-or-no question can start with "Je": "Je, kuna lifti?" (Is there a lift?). "Kuna" means "there is". Breakfast from "saa moja" to "saa nne" is from seven to ten: Swahili hours are counted from sunrise.

title: Familia yangu
text: Jina langu ni Anna. Ninaishi na familia yangu katika nyumba ndogo karibu na mto. Mama yangu ni mwalimu na baba yangu anafanya kazi dukani. Nina kaka mmoja na dada mmoja. Kaka yangu ana miaka kumi na anapenda mpira wa miguu. Dada yangu bado ni mdogo: ana miaka mitatu. Pia tuna mbwa, na jina lake ni Max. Kila asubuhi baba yangu hutembea na mbwa. Jioni tunakula pamoja na kuzungumza kuhusu siku yetu. Baada ya chakula cha jioni, mimi na kaka yangu tunaosha vyombo. Jumapili bibi yangu huja na kuleta keki. Ninaipenda familia yangu sana.
notice: Swahili builds the verb from pieces: "ni-na-ishi" (I-now-live), "a-na-penda" (he-now-likes), "tu-na-kula" (we-now-eat). "Hu-" marks a habit: "hutembea" (walks every day), "huja" (comes). "-ni" on a noun means "in" or "at": "dukani".
back: Mama yangu ni mwalimu na baba yangu anafanya kazi dukani.
My mother is a teacher and my father works in a shop.
Jumapili bibi yangu huja na kuleta keki.
On Sunday my grandmother comes and brings a cake.

title: Mji wetu
text: Mji wetu ni mdogo, lakini ni mzuri. Katikati ya mji kuna uwanja wa zamani wenye chemchemi. Karibu na uwanja kuna shule, duka la dawa na mikahawa miwili. Kituo cha treni kiko nyuma ya bustani. Kila asubuhi watu wengi hupanda treni kwenda jijini. Alasiri watoto hucheza bustanini, na wazee hucheza chesi. Wakati wa kiangazi watalii huja na kupiga picha za daraja. Wakati wa baridi mji huwa kimya. Jumamosi kuna soko uwanjani. Hapo unaweza kununua mboga, asali na maua. Jioni ninapenda kutembea kando ya mto. Sitaki kuishi katika jiji kubwa.

gloss.baridi: cold (wakati wa baridi: the cold season, winter)

notice: "Kuna" means "there is" or "there are": "kuna shule", "kuna soko". Each noun belongs to a class, and the words about it copy its prefix: "mji mdogo" (a small town), "jiji kubwa" (a big city), "mikahawa miwili" (two cafés).
back: Kituo cha treni kiko nyuma ya bustani.
The station is behind the park.
Wakati wa baridi mji huwa kimya.
In winter the town is quiet.

title: Siku ya kuzaliwa ya Bibi
text: Jana ilikuwa siku ya kuzaliwa ya bibi yangu. Sasa ana miaka themanini. Familia nzima ilikuja nyumbani kwake kijijini. Shangazi yangu alioka keki kubwa na mjomba wangu alileta maua. Tulimpa skafu ya joto na kitabu kuhusu bustani. Kabla ya chakula cha mchana tuliimba wimbo, na Bibi alicheka. Mezani kulikuwa na supu, kuku na viazi, na saladi nyingi. Baada ya chakula cha mchana alituonyesha picha za zamani. Katika picha moja alikuwa msichana mwenye baiskeli. Alituambia kwamba aliiendesha kwenda kazini kila siku. Kisha binamu yangu alipiga gitaa na kila mtu alicheza dansi. Hata kaka yangu mdogo alicheza na Bibi. Jioni alikuwa amechoka lakini mwenye furaha. Alisema kwamba ilikuwa siku bora ya kuzaliwa maishani mwake. Tulirudi nyumbani tumechelewa, nyota zikiwa tayari angani.

gloss.kuzaliwa: to be born (siku ya kuzaliwa: birthday)

notice: The past has "-li-" after the person: "a-li-oka" (she baked), "tu-li-imba" (we sang), "i-li-kuwa" (it was). The one something is done to sits inside the verb too: "tu-li-m-pa" (we gave her), "a-li-tu-onyesha" (she showed us).
back: Shangazi yangu alioka keki kubwa na mjomba wangu alileta maua.
My aunt baked a big cake and my uncle brought flowers.
Baada ya chakula cha mchana alituonyesha picha za zamani.
After lunch she showed us old photos.

title: Pochi iliyopotea
text: Ijumaa iliyopita Daniel alitaka kulipa katika duka kubwa, lakini pochi yake haikuwa mfukoni. Alikuwa na wasiwasi sana, kwa sababu kadi yake ya benki na leseni yake ya udereva zilikuwa ndani yake. Aliacha bidhaa zake kwenye kaunta na akarudi kwa njia ileile. Alitafuta kila mahali, kando ya barabara na kwenye kituo cha basi, lakini hakupata chochote. Nyumbani alipiga simu benki na akaifunga kadi. Usiku ule hakuweza kulala, kwa sababu alikuwa akifikiria hati zake zote. Siku mbili baadaye barua kutoka polisi ilifika. Mwanamke mmoja alikuwa ameipata pochi ndani ya basi na kuipeleka kituo cha polisi. Daniel alikwenda huko mara moja. Hakuna kilichopotea, hata pesa. Polisi alimpa anwani ya mwanamke huyo, kwa sababu Daniel alitaka kumshukuru. Siku iliyofuata alinunua maua na kumwandikia kadi. Alishangaa na akamkaribisha kunywa kahawa. Walizungumza kwa saa moja, na sasa ni marafiki wazuri. Tangu hapo Daniel huangalia mfuko wake kila mara kabla ya kushuka kwenye basi.

gloss.kando: side (kando ya barabara: by the roadside)
gloss.kituo: stop, station (kituo cha basi: bus stop)

notice: "Not" changes the front of the verb: "haikuwa" (it was not), "hakupata" (he did not find), "hakuweza" (he could not). "-ka-" tells the next step of a story: "akarudi" (and he went back), "akaifunga" (and he blocked it).
back: Alitafuta kila mahali, kando ya barabara na kwenye kituo cha basi, lakini hakupata chochote.
He looked everywhere, on the pavement and at the bus stop, but he found nothing.
Mwanamke mmoja alikuwa ameipata pochi ndani ya basi na kuipeleka kituo cha polisi.
A woman had found the wallet on the bus and had taken it to the police station.

title: Kwenye kituo cha treni
lines: Habari za asubuhi. Nikusaidie nini?
Nzuri. Ninaomba tiketi moja ya kwenda Dodoma.
Kwenda tu au kwenda na kurudi?
Kwenda na kurudi, tafadhali. Treni ijayo inaondoka lini?
Saa nne na robo asubuhi, kutoka jukwaa namba tatu.
Safari inachukua muda gani?
Kama saa nne. Utahitaji kubadilisha treni Morogoro.
Nitakuwa na muda gani pale?
Dakika ishirini. Zinatosha.
Sawa. Tiketi ni shilingi ngapi?
Shilingi elfu thelathini. Unataka kulipa kwa kadi?
Ndiyo, kwa kadi. Asante sana!

gloss.kurudi: to come back (kwenda na kurudi: return)

questions.q: Treni inaondoka kutoka jukwaa namba ngapi?

notice: Swahili counts the hours from sunrise: "saa nne" (hour four) is ten o'clock, so "saa nne na robo asubuhi" is a quarter past ten in the morning. The future has "-ta-": "utahitaji" (you will need), "nitakuwa" (I will be).

title: Kwa daktari
lines: Habari za asubuhi. Una tatizo gani?
Nzuri, daktari. Koo linaniuma kwa siku tatu sasa, na ninakohoa.
Una homa pia?
Ndiyo, jana usiku ilikuwa nyuzi thelathini na nane na nusu.
Kichwa kinauma pia?
Kidogo, hasa jioni. Pia silali vizuri.
Fungua mdomo, tafadhali. Ndiyo, koo lako ni jekundu sana.
Ni tatizo kubwa? Lazima nifanye kazi wiki hii.
Hapana, lakini unahitaji kupumzika. Kaa nyumbani kwa siku tatu na unywe chai nyingi.
Ninahitaji dawa?
Nitakuandikia dawa ya vidonge. Meza kimoja baada ya kila mlo.
Asante. Nirudi tena nisipopata nafuu?
Ndiyo, rudi wiki ijayo ikiwa bado una homa.
Sawa. Kwa heri, daktari.

gloss.koo: throat (koo linaniuma: I have a sore throat)

questions.q: Koo limemuuma mgonjwa kwa siku ngapi?

notice: What hurts is the subject, and the verb copies its class: "kichwa kinauma" (the head hurts), "koo linaniuma" (the throat hurts me). A command to one person is the bare verb: "fungua" (open), "kaa" (stay), "meza" (swallow).
